title: CIELingo Meaning-Debt Word Cards
purpose: Convert meaning-debt scaffolds into supervised candidate word cards with grammatical and semantic markings for every word.
core_rules: legacy ordinal numbers and filenames are technical provenance only
each word receives a part-of-speech candidate and sentence-part candidate
infinitives are separated as action/predicate seeds
WORD_CARD_PASS remains false until source evidence and human review resolve debt

field_model.word_potential: semantic rest mass multiplied by ln(2)/(24*pi)
field_model.relation_energy: proxy for word energy in relation

description: Karty słów z długiem znaczeniowym CIELingo
